notes.title: LOST ORBIT: Terminal Velocity Announced!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7613808/9e38888972c618d91b004c6f62b5466a20bf62b3.png[/img]

Hey everyone! I can finally announce that we're releasing LOST ORBIT: Terminal Velocity on [b]July 16th![/b]

This is the definitive edition of the game with a brand new 12 level epilogue with new story, abilities and ways to die! We have also added 15 new challenge levels for people looking for something more difficult. 

Terminal Velocity also features a reworking of the original levels with new cinematics, polished gameplay and smoother performance!

Best of all, if you own LOST ORBIT you will receive Terminal Velocity for free on July 16th!! I hope you all enjoy the new adventure and thank you for your support over the years. 

Please do us a huge favour and wishlist the new game. It helps a lot to get exposure! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/372320/LOST_ORBIT_Terminal_Velocity/

notes.title: LOST ORBIT Reviews
notes.content:
[b]The reviews for LOST ORBIT have been amazing so far, check out some highlights![/b]

"Overall, Lost Orbit is a joy to play"
9.1/10 – [url=http://www.hookedgamers.com/pc/lost_orbit/review/article-1479.html] Hooked Gamers [/url]

“from start to finish a great game” 
4.5/5 – [url=http://www.gamingpcforum.com/review-lost-orbit/] Gaming PC Forum  [/url]

“LOST ORBIT‘s biggest success is its balance of ingredients” 
4.5/5 – [url=http://www.psnstores.com/review/review-lost-orbit/] PSNStores  [/url] 

"Lost Orbit could quite possibly be contender for indie game of the year."
9/10 – [url=http://punkandlizard.com/lost-orbit-review-ps4/] Punk and Lizard [/url] 

“If you like dodge ‘em ups then this is one of the best available” 
9/10 – [url=http://www.thesixthaxis.com/2015/05/12/lost-orbit-review/] The Sixth Axis  [/url]

“A bit like Sonic in space”
82/100 – [url=http://www.gamerstemple.com/game-reviews/playstation-4/9758/lost-orbit-review] Gamers temple [/url]

“All in all, Lost Orbit is a winner.”
8/10 – [url=http://www.destructoid.com/review-lost-orbit-291882.phtml] Destructoid [/url]

“A compelling and moving story” 
4/5 – [url=http://gamerant.com/lost-orbit-reviews/] Game Rant [/url]

“Lost Orbit proves itself to be a fast and frantic Runner with some surprising heart” 
8/10 – [url=http://www.gamerheadlines.com/reviews/lost-orbit/] Gamer Headlines [/url]

“You’ll keep coming back for more” 
8/10 – [url=http://gamingtrend.com/reviews/a-meteoric-mash-up-lost-orbit-review/] Gaming Trend [/url]

“If you’re looking for a game that will test your reflexes, Lost Orbit is your game.” 
8/10 – [url=http://www.playstationlifestyle.net/2015/05/11/lost-orbit-review-find-way-home-ps4/#/slide/1] PlayStation Lifestyle [/url]

“Lost Orbit will suck players in with its tight controls and wonderfully constructed story.” 
8/10 – [url=http://www.psu.com/review/26829/Lost-Orbit-PS4-review] PlayStation Universe [/url]

“Lost Orbit surprised me, I didn’t expect it to be as deep and engaging as it turned out to be” 
8/10 – [url=http://www.psnation.com/2015/05/13/review-lost-orbit-ps4/] PSNation [/url]

“The certainty of death and the loneliness of the universe have never been so colorful and fun” 
4/5 – [url=http://wegotthiscovered.com/gaming/lost-orbit-review/] We Got This Covered [/url]

“When everything comes together and your reflexes are sharp, the speed and precision of Lost Orbit's 2D gameplay would make Sonic the Hedgehog jealous.” 
7/10 – [url=http://www.gamespot.com/reviews/lost-orbit-review/1900-6416131/] Gamespot [/url]

notes.title: LOST ORBIT: OUT NOW!!
notes.content: Thanks to everyone for their support!! The game in now available on STEAM!!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - LOST ORBIT, 10% off!
notes.content:
LOST ORBIT is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

Stranded after his ship is destroyed in deep space, Harrison, a lowly maintenance worker and our hero, must struggle to find his way home...



LOST ORBIT centers around the exploration of space. Players take control of a lone astronaut (Harrison) who sets off on a dangerous journey to rejoin his civilization, armed with only an improvised set of equipment and a relentless spirit. Without the help of his ship, Harrison will need to use the gravitational forces of planets to navigate and propel himself through space.

*Offer ends May 19 at 10AM Pacific Time
